title: Integrate frame pacing and optional NVIDIA Reflex
goal: Place pacing and Reflex markers at verified simulation/render/present boundaries.
acceptance: One frame token tracks real frame lifecycle; markers do not block guest jobs incorrectly
Measure end-to-end latency where hardware permits; CPU timings alone not called input-to-photon latency
validation: GPU-bound and CPU-bound A/B tests with and without Reflex
Offline, split-screen, unsupported GPU and minimized/resume tests
